newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Indus new shares priced at 40 dmk.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Indus new shares priced at 40 dmk.

text.p: German investment group Indus Holding AG said on Friday that it would offer new shares at an issue price of 40 marks ($21.44) in a one-for-six rights offering to increase its nominal capital by 11.25 million marks to 78.75 million marks.
The subscription period for the 2.25 million new shares runs from August 14 to August 27, the group said.
The new shares will be entitled to a full dividend in the 1997 business year, Indus said.
The company said later in a mandatory statement that sales in the first half of 1997 had grown 23.8 percent to 213 million marks from 172 million marks.

Indus said turnover in the full-year 1997 could be higher than the 480 million marks it had originally planned and also expected group net earnings to reach 57 million marks in the full year, up from 52.2 million marks last year.
